params: random.seed(0) and numpy.random.seed(0) immediately before each task's generate_random_params(), as harness/run_task.py --seed 0

statuses.eligible: setup and checker run here; the agent acts only through the APK
statuses.policy_blocked: target is a protected OS surface (Settings/SystemUI); classified, never bypassed
statuses.approval_gated: needs a hard confirmation (send/delete) that only the owner can answer; awaits an approval protocol
statuses.checker_needs_adaptation: the AndroidWorld checker reads the default display's UI tree or foreground, but the task runs on the session's virtual display
statuses.setup_unavailable: a setup tool or app the task needs cannot be installed or used on API 37
statuses.app_unavailable: the AndroidWorld app is absent; no substitute app is used
statuses.time_dependent: the checker depends on AndroidWorld's fixed device date, which cannot be set without breaking the APK's TLS model calls
statuses.deferred_session_limit: app installable, but group A already has the six-target session maximum (Clock, Contacts, Simple Calendar Pro, Markor, Pro Expense, Broccoli)

ClockTimerEntry.note: AndroidWorld reads the entered digits from the default display's UI tree; the timer setup entry is not persisted, so no state checker exists

ClockStopWatchRunning.note: adapted: Clock's device-encrypted preferences sw_state == running (AndroidWorld reads the UI tree)

OpenAppTaskEval.note: seed 0 generates 'Open the settings app'; Settings is a protected target. Its checker also reads the default display's foreground activity

TurnOnWifiAndOpenApp.note: seed 0 opens Settings as the second app as well

SimpleSmsSend.note: send; also needs the SMS role for the target (a protected role setting) and its checker requires SMS in the default display's foreground

SimpleCalendarAddOneEvent.deviation: device date stays real (2026); the requested date is in 2023, so the agent navigates further back than in AndroidWorld

SimpleCalendarEventsOnDate.deviation: as SimpleCalendarAddOneEvent; the raw answer text is scored by AndroidWorld's checker on the host

FilesDeleteFile.note: delete; the seed-0 goal also names AndroidWorld's 'sdk_gphone_x86_64' storage label, which differs on this image

CameraTakePhoto.note: AndroidWorld's camera app is absent (this image ships app.grapheneos.camera); emulator camera capture on a session display is also unverified

ClockStopWatchPausedVerify.note: adapted: Stopwatch tab selected and sw_state not running (AndroidWorld reads Start on the Stopwatch UI)

MarkorCreateNoteFromClipboard.note: setup sets the clipboard through AndroidWorld's clipper.apk, which targets SDK < 4 and is below API 37's minimum installable target SDK

SimpleCalendarNextMeetingWithPerson.note: 'next meeting' is relative to AndroidWorld's fixed date (15 Oct 2023)

NotesIsTodo.note: Joplin targets SDK 33; not yet installed or set up

RetroPlayingQueue.note: Retro Music targets SDK 33; not yet installed or set up
